$comment: Single source of truth for local development hosts, ports and nginx routing.
Kept here rather than in each app's package.json because the suite is being
migrated incrementally -- apps still living in their own repos must keep
working alongside the ones already moved into this monorepo.
Cookies from sharpnr-engine are issued with Secure + SameSite=None on
Domain=.sharpnr.test (see config/cookieConfig.go), so every app must be
reachable over HTTPS on a *.sharpnr.test name. Plain http:// on a .test
domain is not a trustworthy origin and the browser will silently drop them.

apps.name: docs
apps.note: VERIFY: the live nginx.conf points docs at 6956, which stockwave also uses, so docs currently serves stockwave. 6954 is a proposed free port; confirm before use.

apps.name: website
apps.note: The marketing site no longer lives in this monorepo, but it is still served locally on 6958 and VITE_WEBSITE_APP points at it, so it keeps a proxy entry here.
